scenario_description:
Objective: Give a confirmed tactile-map zine swap a small visual-access lift through a free print-shop accent sample if it fits the handouts.
Emerging Need: An early maker notice is only a possibility until the swap, packet printing, and same-week sample board align.
Decision Context: Stored access notes determine the useful color boundary that public notices do not supply, while observable records provide title, quantity, dimensions, and cutoff.
Consequence: Catching the window can make the packets easier and nicer to sort; missing it leaves the zines plain but usable.

parameter.subject: This week: free accent-color samples for tiny community zines
parameter.body: We are running a no-cost sample board for small community zines this week. Please do not send requests yet; the board opens Wednesday morning with available colors and reply instructions. Eligible projects need a title, rough dimensions, and pickup by Friday noon. One small accent-color pass per project while slots last.

parameter.content: Jessa and Amos both said Saturday afternoon works for the tactile-map zine swap if you still want to bring the river-route packets. I can help fold at the cafe if copies are ready.

parameter.title: Tactile-map zine swap at Java Junction
parameter.description: Informal swap table for river-route tactile-map mini zines; Elias bringing packet copies.
12 black-and-white half-sheet folded river-route tactile-map zine packets on uncoated stock, pickup Friday 09:00.

parameter.subject: Sample board is open: three free zine accent slots today
parameter.body: The community zine accent board is open now. Available inks today are cherry, fern, and teal. Reply by 4:00 PM with project title, size, pickup day, and one ink choice; we will run up to 12 accent passes per accepted project. No attendee names on the sample sheet, please. For uncoated half-sheet packets from Copy Corner, bring the 12 copies to Makers Press Friday between 09:30 and 10:00; accepted accents will be ready at 11:30, before our noon pickup close. Confirm your stock and handoff when requesting; allocation still requires our reply.

parameter.subject: Community zine accent board is full
parameter.body: Thanks for the interest this morning. Today's free accent-color sample board filled at 4:00 PM, and we cannot add more zine projects before the press cleanup. The next sample day has not been scheduled.
